correctness.rationale: For 0<eps<1 the SPD diagonal family diag(1,1+eps,2) has condition number exactly 2. The first normalized Rayleigh residual has square eps^2(eps^2-2eps+3)/(eps^2+2)^2. The explicit Krylov basis u=(1,1,eps), w=(-1,0,1-eps) yields a symmetric definite 2x2 pencil whose limiting matrices G=[[2,-1],[-1,2]], H=[[2,-1],[-1,3]] have Ritz roots 1 and 5/3. Its larger unit Ritz vector tends to (-1,1,2)/sqrt(6), residual sqrt(2)/3. Since r1/eps ->sqrt(3)/2, r2/r1~2sqrt(6)/(9eps), while the top Ritz value strictly increases and the eigenvalue-error ratio ->1/3. In dimension 2 the second Krylov space is either invariant already or full, hence no positive second residual. Fresh independent symbolic pencil and numerical eigenresidual checks reproduced all central claims. Finite checks do not supply the limiting proof; simplicity and continuity of the limiting pencil do.
